title: Spicy-Sweet Chinese Chicken
description: A hybrid General Tso's and Kung Pao stir fry of marinated diced chicken, broccoli and water chestnuts in a full double batch of glossy sauce.

ingredients.name: marinated diced chicken breast
ingredients.note: marinated in a cornstarch-based marinade ahead of time

ingredients.name: fresh broccoli florets
ingredients.note: Cut into small even florets and add near the end to keep crisp-tender.

ingredients.name: coconut aminos
ingredients.note: Use Coconut Secret Original; dilute in the sauce with unsalted broth.

ingredients.name: chili crisp
ingredients.note: Use mild chile crisp, at the table for individual portions.

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.note: optional, only if you buy a new bottle

ingredients.name: jasmine or white rice
ingredients.note: to serve, microwave rice packs work

steps.title: Mix sauce
steps.text: In a bowl, mix {aminos}, {broth}, {ricevinegar}, {hoisin}, {tomatopaste}, {sugar}, {sesameoil}, {garlicpowder}, {ginger}, {cornstarch} and {fishsauce}.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Pull the marinated chicken from the fridge and let it lose the chill for 5 minutes. Thinly slice {sweetpepper} and cut {broccoli} into small florets.

steps.title: Start rice
steps.text: Start {rice}, using microwave packs or the stovetop.

steps.title: Heat oil
steps.text: Heat {oil} in a large skillet.

steps.title: Cook chicken
steps.text: Add {chicken} and cook on medium-high until lightly browned and mostly cooked through. The cornstarch in the marinade gives that velvety Chinese-restaurant texture. Stir occasionally.

steps.title: Add veggies
steps.text: Add the broccoli and bell pepper and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add sauce
steps.text: Re-stir the sauce, since the cornstarch settles, then pour the entire batch over the chicken and veggies.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer for 4 to 6 minutes until the sauce thickens, the chicken reaches 165°F, the broccoli is tender and everything is glossy.

steps.title: Taste and adjust
steps.text: Taste and adjust: more broth to loosen, more sugar for sweeter, more chile crisp at the table for spicier.

steps.title: Settle
steps.text: Turn off the heat, give a final stir, and let the sauce settle for 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over the rice. Add {chilicrisp} only to portions that want heat.

notes: Uses about 5 cups of diced chicken breast. The marinade is not in the original document; the chicken is assumed to be marinated ahead with a cornstarch-based marinade, so add yours to this file.
